answer: To register, an agent burns a jade-marked voucher tied to its hardware fingerprint and broadcasts a comet-timestamped proof to peers. Each agent must stake a unique pigment token minted from a verified physical sample, making duplicate identities costly to fake. Sybils must acquire new samples and hardware per identity, so attack cost scales linearly with fake accounts while honest agents pay once, keeping the network resistant.
